title: Seeded Gradients, Infinite Galleries, Blow-Out Type, Press Depth & Ink Highlights
description: Five live UI drops: a deterministic seed-driven WebGL gradient field, an infinite parallax gallery with FLIP detail morph, wind-blown scroll typography, press-depth buttons, and a marker-style highlighter reveal.

drops.title: Seed-Driven Gradient Field
drops.description: A short hex seed deterministically drives a WebGL fragment shader's variant, palette, and motion — same seed, same field, forever.
drops.concept: Each seed is parsed into a shader variant (0-3), speed, hue, saturation, and lightness. Six live panels each render their own instance of a value-noise fragment shader whose uniforms come straight from the parsed seed, so identical seeds always reproduce identical motion. Clicking a panel rolls a new random seed; the debug panel edits the primary panel's seed live and can copy a shareable URL hash.
drops.source: metaory/gradient-gl (GitHub) — Tiny WebGL library for deterministic seed-driven procedural gradient animations

interaction.mouse: Click a panel to reroll its seed
interaction.click: Randomize / edit seed / copy share link in the debug panel

drops.title: Infinite Parallax Gallery
drops.description: Four columns loop vertically forever at different speeds with an invisible seam, and tapping a tile FLIP-morphs it into a full detail view.
drops.concept: Each column wraps its scroll offset with modulo arithmetic so tiles that scroll off one edge instantly reappear at the other, and every column moves at its own speed factor for a parallax feel. Clicking a tile captures its on-screen bounding box, then animates a cloned preview element from those exact bounds out to a centered detail size — and reverses the same animation back into the tile's live position on close, the FLIP pattern without any external animation library.
drops.source: Codrops — "Building an Infinite GSAP Scroll Gallery with Parallax and Flip Transitions"

interaction.mouse: Drag or scroll-wheel to loop the columns
interaction.click: Click a tile to FLIP into detail view, click × or backdrop to close
interaction.touch: Drag to scroll, tap a tile to open

drops.title: Wind Blow-Out Type
drops.description: Headlines disperse letter-by-letter along a wind direction as they scroll out of center, then reassemble as they re-center — no canvas particles.
drops.concept: Every letter is its own span carrying a per-letter angle jitter, travel distance, rotation, and stagger delay computed once from a seeded PRNG. A scroll listener converts each row's distance from the viewport's vertical center into a 0-1 'formed' progress value that drives each letter's translateX/Y, rotation, opacity, and blur through CSS custom properties — so the whole effect is per-letter transforms driven by scroll position, not a canvas particle system. A 'Gust now' button plays the same disperse/reform curve on demand for instant payoff.
drops.source: jh3y (Jhey Tompkins) — "Apple Style Blow Out Text with CSS Scroll-Driven Animations" (CodePen)

interaction.mouse: Scroll the panel to disperse/reform each headline
interaction.click: "Gust now" plays an instant disperse-and-reform cycle
interaction.touch: Swipe the panel to scroll through headlines

drops.title: Press-Depth Buttons
drops.description: Buttons physically sink toward the surface and lean away from exactly where you pressed, like a real key — a press reaction, not a hover tilt.
drops.concept: On pointerdown, the press point is normalized to -1..1 across the button's bounds and written to CSS custom properties, which drive a translateY push plus rotateX/rotateY tilt away from that origin, while a shine overlay fades and a hard drop-shadow collapses to a thin one — all reversed instantly on release. Because the tilt is fixed to the press origin rather than continuously following the pointer, it reads as a physical button being pushed rather than a card tilting toward the cursor.
drops.source: ddoemonn/interior (GitHub) — "press-depth" component from a React micro-interactions library

interaction.mouse: Press and hold near different corners of a button to see the tilt change

drops.title: Highlighter Ink Reveal
drops.description: A marker-style highlight sweep built from an animated background-size gradient — triggers on scroll into view, on hover, or click-to-annotate.
drops.concept: Instead of animating background-color (which can't tween), each highlighted span uses a solid-color linear-gradient as its background-image with background-size animated from 0% to 100% width, and box-decoration-break: clone so multi-line spans highlight cleanly per line. Three live demos share the same primitive: an IntersectionObserver-triggered reveal, a hover-triggered set of terms, and a click-to-annotate paragraph with a color-swatch picker that behaves like a real highlighter pen.

interaction.mouse: Hover terms to ink them, scroll to trigger the first block
interaction.click: Click sentences in the third block to toggle highlights; pick a color first
interaction.touch: Tap terms or sentences to toggle
